note: Drawn from three archival albums, so classic pieces such as Tỳ bà hành appear in more than one performance; streaming availability may vary.

size.basis: 56 named forms (thể cách) and a small revival scene (140 performers in 23 clubs by 2011, per Wikipedia); a handful of international label albums (UNESCO/Folkways, Inédit, Nimbus, Buda) of 7-10 tracks each plus Vietnamese CDs and broadcast/archive recordings. Core = the main forms (Bắc phản, Mưỡu, Hát nói, Tỳ bà hành, Thét nhạc, Gửi thư, Ba mươi sáu giọng, etc.) in a few master recordings.
